About Us

Empowering Indian Ecommercewith a Unified Seller Platform

Discover UniSouk
Our Vision

Removing the complexity from modern commerce.

We envision a digital economy where every Indian brand, a startup, or a market leader, can sell effortlessly and grow exponentially. Our platform is designed to break down barriers and open up new opportunities for entrepreneurs across India.

Our Mission

Enabling smarter commerce through automation.

We aim to make online commerce simpler and more accessible by replacing manual processes with intelligent automation. By connecting every part of the commerce journey, we enable businesses to save time, operate more efficiently, and focus on sustainable growth.

Our Story

In today's evolving digital market landscape, sellers often struggle with fragmented tools, complex integrations, and the overwhelming challenge of scaling online. Recognizing this gap, our founders came together with a shared purpose:

To create a unified platform that simplifies every step of the ecommerce journey.

Today, UniSouk, one of the best ecommerce solution providers, stands as a trusted growth partner for brands across India, offering seamless listings, live inventory management, payment integrations, logistics support, and deep analytics through one intuitive dashboard.

The people building UniSouk.

Company direction and technology leadership stay close to the daily realities of building for Indian commerce.

Meet the wider team.

Product, technology, operations and growth working side by side to build a better commerce experience.

The future of commerce is online, and it should be accessible to everyone.

At UniSouk, a leading ecommerce service provider in India, we believe that the future of commerce is online, and it should be accessible to everyone at their fingertips. Founded with a vision to simplify online selling, UniSouk is India’s first truly unified ecommerce SaaS platform developed for D2C brands and marketplace sellers.

Whether you're a new entrepreneur or a market leader, we offer the complete solutions needed to scale effortlessly across digital platforms like Amazon, ONDC, Flipkart, Meesho, and many more.

UniSouk is proudly built by a seasoned team that understands the complexities of modern ecommerce and is passionate about eliminating them for Indian businesses of all kinds.

Frequently asked questions

At UniSouk, a leading ecommerce service provider in India, we believe that the future of commerce is online and it should be accessible to everyone at their fingertips.

What services does UniSouk provide to sellers?

UniSouk is a unified ecommerce partner for Indian D2C brands and marketplace sellers. With a single dashboard, you can list products across marketplaces and your own store, manage inventory in real time, integrate payments, handle logistics, and access analytics, eliminating the hassle of using multiple tools.

How can UniSouk help my business scale?

UniSouk simplifies online selling by syncing your inventory across Amazon, Flipkart, ONDC, Meesho and more, automating orders and shipping, and providing actionable analytics. This helps you save time, avoid overselling, and focus on scaling smoothly.

Does UniSouk support sales on multiple marketplaces?

Yes! UniSouk lets you sell across leading platforms like Amazon, ONDC, Shopify, WooCommerce, and more. Manage everything from one dashboard, with no need to switch between apps or worry about missing an order.

How secure is my data on UniSouk’s platform?

Your data security is our top priority. UniSouk uses trusted encryption standards and secure servers to protect your information. We never share your data with third parties, ensuring your business details remain safe and confidential.

Is UniSouk suitable for new entrepreneurs?

Absolutely! If you're just starting your online journey or already running a brand, UniSouk is designed to meet you where you are. New sellers can set up their store in minutes, with no coding required. Experienced sellers can use our advanced features to streamline operations and maximize growth.

Manage product listings, inventory, orders, shipping, payments and AI agents from one intelligent commerce operating system.

Which channels can I connect?

UniSouk currently connects with Amazon India, ONDC, Meesho, Shopify, Wix, and WooCommerce. Flipkart support is coming soon.

What can I manage with UniSouk?

Manage connected channels, products, orders, inventory, analytics, and seller assistance tools from one place.

Can UniSouk help manage my marketplace accounts?

Yes. Account Management is a separate, hands on service for sellers who want help with onboarding, catalogue quality, and account growth.

What makes UniSouk different from other ecommerce software?

Unlike traditional ecommerce tools that only manage operations, UniSouk combines AI powered automation, marketplace management, and business intelligence in one platform. From optimizing listings and analyzing profits to improving ad performance and managing multiple sales channels, UniSouk helps brands operate and grow their ecommerce business from a single place.

Which marketplaces and ecommerce platforms does UniSouk support?

UniSouk supports major ecommerce marketplaces and platforms, including Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, AJIO, Nykaa Fashion, Etsy, Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, Blinkit, Zepto, and Instamart. We continuously expand our integrations as new sales channels emerge.

What AI Agents does UniSouk offer?

UniSouk currently offers five specialized AI Agents: SoukList, SoukSense, SoukStudio, SoukBoost and SoukLedger. They help audit and optimize product content, identify business opportunities, create channel ready visuals, improve advertising performance and clarify financial insights. More AI Agents are continuously being developed to automate additional ecommerce operations.

Do you provide software, managed services, or both?

Both. You can use UniSouk as a SaaS platform to manage your ecommerce operations independently, or choose our Managed Account Management Services, where a dedicated ecommerce expert handles marketplace operations, advertising, catalogue management, and growth strategy on your behalf.

How long does it take to get started?

Most businesses can begin onboarding within 24 to 48 hours after completing the required documentation. Existing seller accounts go through an initial audit before optimization begins, while new sellers are guided through the complete marketplace onboarding process.

Is UniSouk suitable for businesses of all sizes?

Yes. Whether you’re launching your first product on Amazon or managing multiple brands across marketplaces and quick commerce platforms, UniSouk scales with your business. Our solutions are designed for startups, growing D2C brands, manufacturers, and enterprise sellers.

Privacy Policy

How UniSouk collects, uses, stores and protects information when you use our website and services.

Last updated: 20 May 2024

Policies

This Privacy Policy describes our policies and procedures on the collection, use and disclosure of your information when you use the Service, and explains your privacy rights and how the law protects you.

Interpretation and definitions

Interpretation

The words whose initial letters are capitalized have meanings defined under the following conditions. These definitions have the same meaning whether they appear in singular or plural.

Definitions

  1. Account means a unique account created for you to access our Service or parts of our Service.
  2. Company (referred to as “the Company”, “We”, “Us” or “Our”) refers to NexaNode Technologies Pvt. Ltd., 701, Solaris Cube, Vesu.
  3. Cookies are small files placed on your computer, mobile device or another device, containing details of your browsing history among their uses.
  4. Country refers to Gujarat, India.
  5. Device means any device that can access the Service, such as a computer, cellphone or digital tablet.
  6. Personal Data is any information relating to an identified or identifiable individual.
  7. Service refers to the Website.
  8. Service Provider means a person or company that processes data on behalf of the Company, facilitates the Service, provides related services or helps us analyze how the Service is used.
  9. Third-party Social Media Service refers to a website or social network through which a user can log in or create an account to use the Service.
  10. Usage Data refers to data collected automatically, either generated by use of the Service or from the Service infrastructure.
  11. Website refers to NexaNode Technologies Pvt. Ltd., accessible from www.unisouk.com.
  12. You means the individual accessing or using the Service, or the company or legal entity on whose behalf that individual accesses or uses the Service.

Collecting and using your Personal Data

Personal Data

While using our Service, we may ask you to provide personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you. This may include:

  • Email address
  • First name and last name
  • Phone number
  • Address, State, Province, ZIP or Postal code, and City
  • Usage Data

Usage Data

Usage Data is collected automatically when using the Service. It may include your Device’s Internet Protocol address, browser type and version, pages visited, the time and date of your visit, time spent on those pages, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.

When you access the Service through a mobile device, we may automatically collect information including the type of mobile device, its unique ID, its IP address, its operating system, the mobile browser used, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.

We may also collect information your browser sends whenever you visit or access the Service through a mobile device.

Tracking technologies and cookies

We use Cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our Service, store certain information and improve and analyze the Service. Technologies we use may include:

  • Cookies or Browser Cookies. A Cookie is a small file placed on your Device. You can instruct your browser to refuse Cookies or indicate when a Cookie is being sent. If you do not accept Cookies, some parts of the Service may not function.
  • Flash Cookies. Certain features may use locally stored objects to collect and store information about preferences or activity. These are not managed by the same browser settings used for Browser Cookies.
  • Web Beacons. Sections of our Service and emails may contain small electronic files that allow us to count visitors or opened emails and gather related website statistics.

Cookies may be Persistent or Session Cookies. Persistent Cookies remain on your device when you go offline, while Session Cookies are deleted when you close your browser.

Necessary or Essential Cookies

These Session Cookies are administered by us and are essential to provide services available through the Website, authenticate users and help prevent fraudulent use of user accounts.

Cookies Policy or Notice Acceptance Cookies

These Persistent Cookies are administered by us and identify whether users have accepted the use of Cookies on the Website.

Functionality Cookies

These Persistent Cookies let us remember choices such as login details or language preferences, providing a more personal experience and avoiding repeated entry of preferences.

Use of your Personal Data

The Company may use Personal Data for the following purposes:

  1. To provide and maintain our Service, including monitoring its use.
  2. To manage your Account and registration, giving access to the relevant Service functionality.
  3. For performance of a contract, including development, compliance and undertaking of a purchase contract or another contract with us.
  4. To contact you by email, telephone, SMS or equivalent electronic communication regarding updates, products, services and security information when necessary.
  5. To provide news, special offers and general information about similar goods, services and events unless you opt out.
  6. To manage your requests.
  7. For business transfers, including evaluating or conducting a merger, divestiture, restructuring, reorganisation, dissolution, sale or transfer of assets.
  8. For other purposes including data analysis, identifying usage trends, evaluating campaigns and improving our Service, products, marketing and your experience.

We may share Personal Data with Service Providers, during business transfers, with affiliates, with business partners, with other users where information is posted publicly, or for another purpose with your consent.

Retention and transfer of your Personal Data

The Company retains Personal Data only for as long as necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We retain and use it as needed to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes and enforce legal agreements and policies.

Usage Data is generally retained for a shorter period unless it is used to strengthen security or improve Service functionality, or a longer period is legally required.

Transfer of your Personal Data

Your information is processed at the Company’s operating offices and other places where the parties involved in processing are located. This means information may be transferred to and maintained on computers outside your state, province, country or jurisdiction where data protection laws may differ.

Your consent to this Privacy Policy followed by submission of information represents your agreement to that transfer. The Company takes reasonably necessary steps to treat data securely and in accordance with this Policy, and will not transfer Personal Data unless adequate controls are in place.

Disclosure of your Personal Data

If the Company is involved in a merger, acquisition or asset sale, Personal Data may be transferred. We will provide notice before it is transferred and becomes subject to a different Privacy Policy.

Under certain circumstances, the Company may be required to disclose Personal Data by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities.

The Company may disclose Personal Data in good faith where necessary to comply with a legal obligation, protect Company rights or property, prevent or investigate wrongdoing, protect the safety of Service users or the public, or protect against legal liability.

Security and privacy protections

Security of your Personal Data

The security of your Personal Data is important to us. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is completely secure. While we use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Children’s privacy

Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from anyone under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and become aware that a child has provided Personal Data, please contact us.

If we learn that we collected Personal Data from anyone under 13 without verification of parental consent, we take steps to remove it. Where consent is a legal basis and a country requires parental consent, we may require that consent before collecting and using information.

Links to other websites

Our Service may contain links to websites not operated by us. We advise you to review the Privacy Policy of every site you visit. We have no control over and assume no responsibility for third-party content, privacy policies or practices.

Changes to this Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the new Policy on this page, update the “Last updated” date and, where appropriate, provide notice by email or prominently within the Service.

Contact us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:

Email: support@unisouk.com

Subscribers may cancel recurring subscriptions at any time through the billing dashboard or customer support portal.

4.2 Cancellation effects

  • The account remains active until the end of the current billing cycle.
  • No refund is provided for the unused portion of the current billing period, except as specified in Section 5.
  • Access to premium features ends when the billing cycle concludes.

5. Refund eligibility and conditions

5.1 Eligible refund scenarios

Subscription fees

  • Billing errors: Incorrect charges, duplicate billing or unauthorized charges originating from our end.
  • Technical service failures: Our platform is unavailable for more than 48 consecutive hours due to an issue on our end, and our support team cannot resolve it within five business days.

Transaction or commission fees

  • Commission charges incorrectly calculated or applied due to technical errors.
  • Multiple deductions for the same transaction due to system errors.
  • Commission charged on orders later cancelled or that failed to process.

5.2 Non-refundable scenarios

Subscription fees

  • Change of business requirements or change of mind after the trial period.
  • Failure to cancel before the renewal date.
  • Force majeure events affecting service availability.
  • Integration issues with third-party platforms beyond our control.

Transaction or commission fees

  • Normal business operations and successfully processed transactions.
  • Commission on completed sales under agreed terms.
  • Market fluctuations affecting business performance.

5.3 Refund request timeline

  • Subscription refunds must be requested within seven days of the billing date.
  • Transaction or commission refunds must be requested within 30 days of the disputed charge.
  • Technical issue refunds must be reported within seven days of the service disruption.

6. Refund request process

6.1 How to request a refund

Send refund requests to accounts@unisouk.com with:

  • Account details and registered email
  • Subscription or transaction details
  • A detailed explanation of the refund reason
  • Supporting documentation such as screenshots or transaction IDs

6.2 Review process

  • Acknowledgment within two business days.
  • Investigation and decision within seven business days.
  • Email notification of approval or rejection with reasons.

6.3 Refund processing

  • Approved refunds are processed within five to ten business days.
  • Refunds are credited to the original payment method only.
  • Processing time may vary depending on the bank or payment provider.
  • Refund confirmation is sent by email.

7. Failed refunds

7.1 Common reasons

  • Expired or invalid payment method
  • Closed bank account
  • Incorrect payment details
  • Bank or card issuer restrictions

7.2 Resolution process

  • Customer notification within two business days.
  • Alternative refund methods offered where possible.
  • Manual bank transfer for unresolved cases, with transfer charges borne by the customer.

8. Dispute resolution

8.1 Internal resolution

Customers must contact our support team for dispute resolution before initiating chargebacks or external complaints.

8.2 Escalation process

  • Level 1: Customer Support at accounts@unisouk.com
  • Level 2: Management Review at management@unisouk.com
  • Level 3: Legal or external mediation

8.3 Chargeback policy

Unjustified chargebacks may result in account suspension and recovery of associated costs.

9. Special circumstances

9.1 Force majeure

No refunds are provided for service interruptions caused by natural disasters, pandemics, government actions, third-party service outages, or internet and network infrastructure failures beyond our control.

9.2 Account violations

No refunds are provided for accounts suspended or terminated due to violation of the Terms of Service, fraudulent activity, misuse of platform features or non-compliance with platform policies.

10. Legal compliance

10.1 Indian law compliance

This Policy complies with the Consumer Protection Act, 2019; Information Technology Act, 2000; Foreign Exchange Management Act; and Goods and Services Tax regulations.

10.2 Payment gateway compliance

This Policy aligns with requirements of authorized payment gateways, including but not restricted to Razorpay and other integrated providers.

11. Data and privacy

11.1 Data retention

  • Transaction data is retained according to regulatory requirements.
  • Refund-related communications are archived for three years.

11.2 Privacy protection

All refund processes comply with our Privacy Policy and applicable data protection laws.

12. Policy updates

12.1 Modification rights

Nexanode Technologies Private Limited reserves the right to modify this Policy with 30 days’ advance notice by email and an updated Policy posted on the website. Continued use constitutes acceptance of changes.

12.2 Grandfathering

Existing subscriptions remain subject to the Policy in effect at the time of purchase unless the customer opts into new terms.

This Policy is governed by the laws of India. Any disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts in Surat, Gujarat, India.

Amazon Seller Central

We provide a unified solution for managing your Amazon presence effectively.

Product Listing Management

  • Create and update product listings directly through UniSouk
  • Manage A+ content for enhanced descriptions
  • Synchronize product information across sales channels
  • Manage product images and media

Pricing and Inventory Management

  • Set and adjust prices through an intuitive interface
  • Track inventory across platforms in real time
  • Automate stock level updates

Amazon Fulfillment / FBA

  • View FBA inventory availability
  • Plan and monitor inbound shipments
  • Track shipment and fulfillment status

Order Management

  • View all Amazon orders in one place
  • Run an efficient order processing workflow
  • Automate order status updates
  • Keep order information synchronized

Performance Analytics

  • Review a comprehensive KPI dashboard
  • Explore sales analytics with customizable ranges
  • Track product category performance
  • Turn data into useful growth insights

Finance and Accounting

  • View settlements, payments, fees, refunds and reimbursements
  • Reconcile Amazon financial activity with seller records
  • Prepare accounting ready revenue and fee summaries

Direct to Consumer Shipping

  • Generate shipping labels and coordinate deliveries
  • Track shipments across marketplaces
  • Ensure seamless fulfillment for all orders

Tax Invoicing

  • Create GST and tax invoices for eligible Amazon orders
  • Track invoice status and documentation
  • Maintain legally required tax invoice records

Tax Remittance

  • Calculate order level tax amounts using Amazon tax data
  • Reconcile collected and remitted tax information
  • Maintain GST and accounting tax records
